applicabilityBasis.summary: USDF is minted at a 1:1 USDT reference and redeemed for USDT after a 0.1% fee. Strategy profits accrue to the separate asUSDF token. The enacted payment-stablecoin definition requires payment or settlement design and an issuer obligation for a fixed amount of monetary value. Aster terms do not identify the legal token issuer or establish a direct currency or deposit repayment obligation. These unresolved rights keep applicability unclear; crypto redemption and yield marketing alone do not establish exclusion.

genius.notes: Aster terms updated February 25, 2026 exclude U.S.-located and U.S.-organized platform users and apply Hong Kong law. They name only Aster, so issuerEntity and issuerDomicile remain omitted. Ceffu is identified as custodian, not token issuer. The prior D17 applicability caution is retained. GENIUS authorization research is separate from scope. No token-specific public authorization was located on October 7, 2026. The pre-effective GENIUS DASP status does not override issuer platform restrictions.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: The opened OCC licensing table and NYDFS directory contain no matching Aster USDF or Aster / Astherus entry. The opened regulator rulemaking materials and current issuer disclosures provide no token-specific GENIUS approval, pending application or foreign registration. Scoped regulator-domain and issuer-intent searches located no qualifying public authorization or enforcement record. These are bounded public-source findings; confidential or unindexed filings are not excluded. The Treasury procedural rule is not issuer approval.
